image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two stacked audio cassette tapes. The top cassette is a standard transparent plastic shell with a white paper label featuring reversed/gibberish text and hand-drawn doodles. The bottom cassette appears to be black or dark gray with a beige label strip containing handwritten characters. The image focuses on the mechanical details: the dual spools, the central rectangular window, and the write-protect tabs.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the main label is nonsensical, reversed, and malformed ('PIA...'). It mimics the visual texture of text but fails semantic coherence, a strong indicator of AI generation.

artifact_observations.location: Handwritten text on bottom cassette label
artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters 'N F S N E' appear slightly floating and lack realistic ink bleed or pressure variation typical of marker on paper.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of top cassette label
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring/fusion where the label meets the plastic casing edge; boundaries are not perfectly sharp.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly identified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular electronic device.
To rigorously analyze the gibberish text artifacts and determine if they are mere noise or failed character rendering.
To verify the physical continuity of the plastic shell and ensure the 'transparent' areas don't have boundary bleeding issues.
To assess the overall realism of lighting and reflections on the plastic surface.

focus_areas: Text legibility and coherence on labels
Structural integrity of the plastic casing edges
Realism of reflections on the transparent plastic
Correct geometry of the spool windows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the labels. While the structure of the cassette is good, the text is a primary failure mode for AI. Check if the 'gibberish' is consistent with OCR errors or pure hallucination. Also, verify if the transparency of the top cassette realistically distorts the background/label behind it.
